insights.headline: Gold held its rebound near $4,158 ahead of US PPI, while MCX gold futures climbed to ₹1.47 lakh/10g on firm spot demand.
insights.summary: September US CPI came in hot at 3.7% year-on-year, reviving bets on an October Fed rate hike and briefly pushing spot gold below $4,100 while silver plunged 6%. On Thursday gold recovered 1.3% to $4,158.63 as the dollar slipped from an 18-month high and silver steadied above $56. Markets now await US producer-price inflation and retail sales at 1230 GMT for the next policy signal. In India, MCX gold futures climbed to ₹1.47 lakh per 10 grams and silver futures to ₹2.08 lakh per kg, while the rupee rose 31 paise to 94.86, with festive-season jewellery demand picking up as prices eased.
points: Spot gold +1.3% to $4,158.63, December futures +1.8% to $4,180; silver +1.1% to $56.26 as the dollar retreated from an 18-month high.
Traders price a ~27% chance of a rate hike at the Oct 27-28 Fed meeting (was 22%); US PPI and retail sales land at 1230 GMT Thursday.
India: MCX gold futures ₹1.47L/10g, silver ₹2.08L/kg on fresh longs; 24K ₹1,47,680 (+1.09%), silver ₹2,09,060/kg (+0.35%); rupee +31p to 94.86.
Gold ETFs drew ₹4,451 crore in September, the busiest month for inflows in recent data.
Policy watch: RBI set the SGB 2019-20 Series V premature redemption at ₹14,725; DGFT sped up silver imports via IIBX.

trending.title: Rebound holds ahead of US PPI
trending.summary: Gold held near $4,158 and silver above $56 after the CPI selloff; MCX futures climbed on firm spot demand. US PPI at 1230 GMT is the next catalyst.

trending.title: Festive buying picks up as prices ease
trending.summary: With Navratri underway, easing prices are pulling shoppers back: jewellery demand is recovering and buyers are shifting to diamond pieces priced ₹10,000–₹1 lakh.

trending.title: Silver's rougher ride
trending.summary: Silver fell harder than gold on the CPI shock, dropping 6%, and remains the more volatile metal; it steadied on Thursday as crude oil's five-day rally ended.

trending.title: Policy and official-sector moves
trending.summary: RBI priced the SGB 2019-20 Series V premature redemption at ₹14,725 per unit; DGFT sped up silver imports through IIBX and nominated agencies; a silver refinery certification scheme was launched.

items.title: Gold rebounds from one-week low as dollar slips
items.summary: Spot gold rose 1.3% to $4,158.63 an ounce on Thursday, rebounding from its lowest since October 7, as the dollar retreated from an 18-month high. US gold futures for December delivery gained 1.8% to $4,180, while spot silver added 1.1% to $56.26. Traders now see about a 27% chance of a rate hike at the October 27-28 Fed meeting after September CPI came in hot at 3.7% year-on-year.

items.title: Gold futures climb to ₹1.47 lakh/10g, silver to ₹2.08 lakh/kg on firm spot demand
items.summary: MCX gold futures rose to ₹1.47 lakh/10g on fresh long positions amid firm spot demand, tracking New York gains. Silver futures added 0.27% to ₹2.08 lakh/kg. VT Markets' Justin Khoo flagged $4,280 as gold's next level to watch with $4,055 support, and silver levels at $58.95/$57.40. US PPI and retail sales at 1230 GMT are the next catalyst; the rupee rose 31 paise to 94.86 in early trade.

items.title: Gold, silver rates today, October 15: Prices rebound after recent fall; 5 things shoppers should know this festive season
items.summary: Gold and silver rebounded in early trade on Thursday ahead of the festive season. India Bullion Rates put 24-carat gold at ₹1,47,680 per 10 grams, up 1.09%, and silver at ₹2,09,060 per kg, up 0.35%, at 9:40 AM IST. On MCX, December gold futures rose 1.22% to ₹1,47,626 and silver futures gained 0.66% to near ₹2.10 lakh per kg. September gold-ETF inflows were ₹4,451 crore.

items.title: Gold falls below $4,100, silver plunges 6% as hot CPI boosts Fed-hike bets - Kitco PM Report
items.summary: Gold and silver fell sharply in late US trading on Wednesday after hotter-than-expected US inflation lifted Treasury yields and the dollar. Spot gold traded near $4,098.80, down $61.30 (1.47%); spot silver near $55.41, down $3.64 (6.16%), with selling accelerating across precious metals. The S&P 500 fell 1.1% in its worst day since July.

items.title: Iran shifting tactics to step up attacks on shipping before US vote, officials say
items.summary: Iran is deploying new tactics to target ships in the Strait of Hormuz to keep oil prices high and influence the US midterm elections, two senior Iranian officials told Reuters. Tehran has restricted the strait since US-Israeli strikes on February 28, with attacks stepping up about 10 days ago. Energy-led inflation risk complicates the Fed's path and keeps a defensive bid under gold.

items.title: India's hidden gold chest is giving imported bullion a run for its money
items.summary: Soaring prices are pushing Indians to exchange old jewellery for new designs rather than cut festive purchases, the Economic Times reports. Old-gold exchanges accounted for over 50% of transactions at Tanishq, more than 55% of sales at Kalyan Jewellers and 73% at Joyalukkas in August — recycled domestic supply that softens import demand.

items.title: Gold jewellery gets costlier as prices surge 54%; shoppers turn to Rs 10,000-Rs 1 lakh diamond pieces
items.summary: With gold prices up 54%, Indian shoppers are shifting to diamond pieces priced ₹10,000–₹1 lakh, which jewellers are making accessible in 18, 14 and even 9-carat gold, the Times of India reports. Joyalukkas has seen an uptick in diamond sales and Senco expects 20% growth in diamond jewellery this festive season.

items.title: Gold Loses Shine Amid Navratri: Yellow Metal Prices Fall Below Rs 1,48,000; Silver Prices Drop By Over Rs 2,000
items.summary: MCX gold December futures slipped below ₹1,48,000 amid Fed rate-hike uncertainty and a stronger rupee, while silver futures dropped ₹2,195 to ₹2,17,022 per kg, NDTV Profit reports. The pullback comes as Navratri shopping gets underway, with the rupee's appreciation muting global cues.

items.title: China Is Aggressively Buying Gold As Prices Fall. Should Indian Buyers Be Worried Or Hopeful?
items.summary: China is aggressively adding gold to its reserves even as prices fall — a long-term strategic move rather than a short-term trade, News18 reports. The buying could put a floor under prices but guarantees nothing, so Indian buyers may see some relief without a price collapse.

items.title: Silver Steadies as Oil Prices Retreat
items.summary: Silver steadied above $56 an ounce on Thursday after the previous session's sharp fall, as crude oil ended a five-day rally. US CPI ran at 3.7% in September, a four-month high. Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee called the figures discouraging; San Francisco Fed President Mary Daly said further hikes may be needed, but saw no immediate need at this month's meeting.

items.title: Decoding India's inflation: Onions, silver key drivers; more storage capacity will make RBI's task easier
items.summary: September CPI inflation of 5.54% was driven by rising onion and silver prices along with related transport costs, ThePrint reports. Building more onion storage capacity would make the RBI's inflation-management task easier — a reminder that silver's rally feeds directly into India's price pressures.

items.title: Gold prices fall 1 percent on MCX as rupee's sharp appreciation weighs on bullion
items.summary: Gold traded weak on October 14 as the rupee's sharp appreciation against the dollar pressured domestic bullion ahead of the US CPI release. MCX spot gold slipped 1.03% to Rs 1,45,615 per 10 grams while December futures eased 0.33% to Rs 1,47,956; international spot gold held just above $4,150 an ounce. items.title: RBI sets ₹14,725 premature redemption price for SGB 2019-20 Series V
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has fixed the premature redemption price of Sovereign Gold Bond 2019-20 Series V at ₹14,725 per unit for the redemption due on October 15, 2026. The price is the simple average of IBJA's 999-purity gold closing prices over the three business days before redemption. The tranche was issued in October 2019; the request window for this cycle closed on October 5.

items.title: DGFT Speeds Up Silver Imports Through IIBX & Nominated Agencies
items.summary: DGFT’s Trade Notice No. 30/2026-27 (13 October 2026) introduced a simplified, expedited procedure for silver import authorisations covering specified ITC(HS) codes, excluding silver dore. Applicants must declare imports at the generally applicable duty rate and justify quantities; each authorisation is valid for six months. Silver must be procured only through IIBX or nominated banks and agencies.

items.title: Pralhad Joshi Launches Silver Refinery Certification Scheme
items.summary: Consumer Affairs Minister Pralhad Joshi launched a BIS certification scheme for silver refineries and mints at a World Standards Day event in New Delhi. Under the scheme, BIS will license qualified facilities, bringing silver bullion and coins under hallmarking-style purity and traceability checks; he also announced seven new Indian Standards and a Digital Standard Reader.

items.title: Gold worth millions seized in three smuggling bids on UAE-Delhi routes
items.summary: Three gold-smuggling attempts on UAE-India air routes were foiled in recent weeks, including 6.5 kg valued at about Dh3.8 million hidden under aircraft seats and two October 10 seizures at Delhi airport — 241 grams concealed in trolley-bag linings and gold paste worth about Dh323,000 hidden in socks. items.title: Gold ETFs or jewellery stocks: Where should investors place festive bets?
items.summary: Analysts see the clearer festive opportunity in organised jewellery retailers rather than the metal itself, recommending jewellers ahead of Dhanteras on November 6 while keeping gold ETFs as a long-term 10-15% allocation. Named stocks include Titan, Kalyan, Senco Gold, PC Jeweller, Sky Gold, TBZ and Thangamayil. AMFI data show 2026 gold ETF inflows of Rs 45,923 crore with outflows only in May.

items.title: Gold Jewellery Demand Recovers as Prices Ease
items.summary: Gold jewellery demand is recovering as prices ease from record highs, with buyers resuming purchases they had postponed. Sales at Delhi's Dariba Kalan market rose nearly 20%. In the June quarter, Kalyan Jewellers' India revenue grew over 38% with same-store sales up 28%, while Titan and Senco Gold also reported strong growth.

items.title: Lemonn adds commodity derivatives, enters MCX with six metals and energy contracts
items.summary: Lemonn (Nu Investors Technologies) launched commodity futures and options on MCX covering gold and silver, copper, zinc, aluminium, crude oil and natural gas. Co-founder Ashish Singhal said it brings exchange-traded derivatives onto one platform. India's commodity-derivatives turnover hit ₹183.3 lakh crore in FY26, per SEBI; agri and electricity contracts are planned pending approvals.
